title: Law and rights
learning_outcomes: Explain law ethics rights in the context of law and rights.
Compare and distinguish jurisdictions and institutions in the context of law and rights.
Apply source hierarchy in the context of law and rights.
Evaluate and justify decisions about due process in the context of law and rights.

lessons.title: Law ethics rights
lessons.outcome: Explain law ethics rights in the context of law and rights.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving law ethics rights; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to legal literacy case.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain law ethics rights from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of law ethics rights; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Jurisdictions and institutions
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish jurisdictions and institutions in the context of law and rights.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving jurisdictions and institutions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to legal literacy case.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain jurisdictions and institutions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of jurisdictions and institutions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Source hierarchy
lessons.outcome: Apply source hierarchy in the context of law and rights.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving source hierarchy; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to legal literacy case.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain source hierarchy from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of source hierarchy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Due process
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about due process in the context of law and rights.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving due process; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to legal literacy case.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain due process from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of due process; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of law ethics rights; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of jurisdictions and institutions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of source hierarchy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of due process; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Historian, economist, legal or policy specialist as appropriate.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
